name: Belt Conveyors
description: A belt conveyor is a mechanical handling system consisting of two or more pulleys with a continuous loop of material (belt) that rotates around them. It is widely used to transport materials efficiently over short or long distances.
features: Efficient Material Handling : Enables continuous and smooth transport of materials.
Cost-effective : Reduces labor costs and increases productivity.
Versatile : Can handle a wide range of materials bulk or unit items.
Customizable : Adjustable speed, length, and design for specific needs.
Safe Operation : Minimizes manual handling and reduces workplace injuries.
